title: Access requests not persisted to database
description: Agent successfully created access requests (received HTTP 200/201 responses), but verification found zero access-request records in the platform database. The access-request creation endpoint accepts requests but does not persist them.
reproduction_steps: POST to /access-requests with valid toolkit_id and api_credential_id
Query GET /access-requests or check database directly
expected_behavior: Access request should be created and persisted in the database, queryable via GET /access-requests.
actual_behavior: HTTP response indicates success, but database contains no access-request records. Agent narration claims approval occurred, but no records exist.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Verification FAILED: no access-requests found in platform database (0 records). Agent narration claims access request was created and approved, but ground truth shows zero access requests exist.'
Logged observation: 'Verification FAILED: no access-requests in database (0 records). Agent narration claims access was approved, but verification found no approved access request.'

title: Broker execution requests not logged to execution history
description: Agent made successful HTTP requests through the broker (58 GET requests to test API were received and returned 200 responses), but no execution records were created in the platform database. Execution tracking failed to capture broker activity.
reproduction_steps: Authenticate as an agent with toolkit access
Make a GET request through the broker endpoint
Receive successful HTTP 200 response with data
expected_behavior: Each broker request should create an execution record with status, timestamps, and request/response details, queryable via GET /executions.
actual_behavior: Broker accepts requests and returns successful responses, but no execution records are created. Test API logs show 58 requests were received, but platform execution history is empty.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Agent made 58 direct GET requests to test API but none were logged as executions in platform database. Broker or execution tracking system failed to record activity despite successful HTTP responses.'
Logged observation: 'Verification FAILED (0.33 score): no execution records exist in platform database (0 records). However, test API logs show 58 GET /get requests were received.'

title: Execution history endpoint returns empty results
description: The execution history endpoint returns zero records despite agent activity. This is a downstream effect of the broker execution logging failure—no executions are being recorded, so the history endpoint has nothing to return.
expected_behavior: GET /executions should return a list of execution records for the agent's broker calls.
actual_behavior: Returns empty array (0 records) even after successful broker requests.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Verification FAILED: no execution records found (0 records). Agent narration claims execution history was queried and showed successful broker call, but platform database contains no executions.'

title: Audit event records contain null/incomplete fields
description: Audit log entries have null values for critical fields (event_type, actor, resource), making the audit trail incomplete and reducing auditability. Events are recorded but lack essential metadata.
reproduction_steps: Observe: event_type, actor, and resource fields are null
expected_behavior: All audit events should have complete metadata including event_type (e.g., 'agent.registered', 'token.issued'), actor (agent ID or system), and resource (affected resource ID).
actual_behavior: Event records are created but critical fields are null, limiting the usefulness of the audit trail.
evidence: Logged observation: 'Audit event records contain null fields (event_type, actor, resource); event data is incomplete and sparse, limiting auditability.'
